summary: American Rebel Holdings filed an 8-K reporting September 2, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreements with Monroe Street Capital Partners and Lambda Ventures for convertible promissory notes totaling $137,500 principal: $82,500 Monroe and $55,000 Lambda, each with original issue discount, 15% one-time interest, and $5,000 legal-fee payments, yielding $115,000 net. Notes mature in twelve months, amortize monthly from March 1, 2027, and convert at 75% of the lowest five-day traded price, with default penalties at 150% plus 22% default interest. Proceeds fund operational consolidation and working capital.
